signal_stop: Original hash-verified candidate plan, closed history max120, same warmup/segments as frozen FF. No stop changes or parameter search.

sizing.existing_cap_source: Frozen management-policy.json max_order_risk_fraction=.005; existing provisional laboratory policy, not a live-account attestation
sizing.common_equity: min(baseline cash equity,H1 cash equity) at a common flat entry; no future settlement recognized early
sizing.volume: round down by .01, min .01, max10; also existing max_notional_multiple2; reject if minimum lot breaches budget

eligibility: Both arms must be flat and both cash equities known. Generate same original plan on closed candles; any arm busy vetoes both. This joint cohort is a target ablation, not two independently scheduled strategy portfolios.
settlement: Recorded outcome is scheduled for its bar-close timestamp; no equity update before that timestamp. Any unresolved outcome blocks both arms.

cohorts.independent_segments: Each original contiguous segment is an explicitly independent FLAT/10000 scenario. Unknown blocks remainder of that segment; next segment is a separate reset scenario, never continuation or annual compounding.
cohorts.continuous_known_prefix: Cash carried across flat segments only while both arms known; first unresolved blocks every later segment. No reset of unknown equity.

mtm: Observed bar-open liquidation and bar-close liquidation under frozen costs until earliest uncertain event. Report sampled-prefix MTM DD, never exact intrabar DD. Unknown exposure has no invented close or swap.
tick_grid: Keep exact1.5R, no silent rounding; count targets off declared .01 tick as executable-price uncertainty
screening: PF>1.10 and earlier protocol gates are descriptive screens only; no STOP uplift, no replication claim
